ABOMASNOW.dex_entry: If it sees any packs of Darumaka going after Snover, it chases them off, swinging its sizable arms like hammers.

ABRA.dex_entry: This Pokémon uses its psychic powers while it sleeps. The contents of Abra's dreams affect the powers that the Pokémon wields.

ABSOL.dex_entry: Long ago, superstitions were spread about it, saying it brought disaster. This fed a hatred of it, and it was driven deep into the mountains.

ACCELGOR.dex_entry: It moves with blinding speed and lobs poison at foes. Featuring Accelgor as a main character is a surefire way to make a movie or comic popular.

AEGISLASH_BLADE.dex_entry: This stance is dedicated to offense. It can cleave any opponent with the strength and weight of its steel blade.

AEGISLASH_SHIELD.dex_entry: In this defensive stance, Aegislash uses its steel body and a force field of spectral power to reduce the damage of any attack.

AERODACTYL.dex_entry: A Pokémon from the age of the dinosaurs. It used its sawlike fangs to shred its prey before eating them.

AGGRON.dex_entry: Aggron claims an entire mountain as its own territory. It mercilessly beats up anything that violates its environment. This Pokémon vigilantly patrols its territory at all times.

AIPOM.dex_entry: Aipom's tail ends in a hand-like appendage that can be cleverly manipulated. However, because the Pokémon uses its tail so much, its real hands have become rather clumsy.

ALAKAZAM.dex_entry: It has an incredibly high level of intelligence. Some say that Alakazam remembers everything that ever happens to it, from birth till death.

ALCREMIE.dex_entry: Cream pours endlessly from this Pokémon's body. The cream stiffens when compressed by an impact. A harder impact results in harder cream.

ALOMOMOLA.dex_entry: It uses its special mucus to close the wounds of injured Pokémon. The reason for this behavior remains unknown.

ALTARIA.dex_entry: Altaria dances and wheels through the sky among billowing, cotton-like clouds. By singing melodies in its crystal-clear voice, this Pokémon makes its listeners experience dreamy wonderment.

AMAURA.dex_entry: This ancient Pokémon was restored from part of its body that had been frozen in ice for over 100 million years.

AMBIPOM.dex_entry: They work in large colonies and make rings by linking their tails, apparently in friendship.

AMOONGUSS.dex_entry: This Pokémon puffs poisonous spores at its foes. If the spores aren't washed off quickly, they'll grow into mushrooms wherever they land.

AMPHAROS.dex_entry: Ampharos gives off so much light that it can be seen even from space. People in the old days used the light of this Pokémon to send signals back and forth with others far away.

ANORITH.dex_entry: Anorith was regenerated from a prehistoric fossil. This primitive Pokémon once lived in warm seas. It grips its prey firmly between its two large claws.

APPLETUN.dex_entry: Eating a sweet apple caused its evolution. A nectarous scent wafts from its body, luring in the bug Pokémon it preys on.

APPLIN.dex_entry: It spends its entire life inside an apple. It hides from its natural enemies, bird Pokémon, by pretending it's just an apple and nothing more.

ARAQUANID.dex_entry: It launches water bubbles with its legs, drowning prey within the bubbles. This Pokémon can then take its time to savor its meal.

ARBOK.dex_entry: This Pokémon is terrifically strong in order to constrict things with its body. It can even flatten steel oil drums. Once Arbok wraps its body around its foe, escaping its crunching embrace is impossible.

ARCANINE.dex_entry: The sight of it running over 6,200 miles in a single day and night has captivated many people.

ARCEUS.dex_entry: According to the legends of Sinnoh, this Pokémon emerged from an egg and shaped all there is in this world.

ARCHEN.dex_entry: It is the ancestor of all bird Pokémon. Archen itself could not actually fly but moved by hopping from treetop to treetop.

ARCHEOPS.dex_entry: Although apparently able to fly, they tended to run along the ground, averaging speeds of roughly 25 mph.

ARCTOVISH.dex_entry: Though it's able to capture prey by freezing its surroundings, it has trouble eating the prey afterward because its mouth is on top of its head.

ARCTOZOLT.dex_entry: The shaking of its freezing upper half is what generates its electricity. It has a hard time walking around.

ARIADOS.dex_entry: There are some areas where people use the string Ariados spins for their own weaving. The resulting cloth is popular for its strength.

ARMALDO.dex_entry: Armaldo's tough armor makes all attacks bounce off. This Pokémon's two enormous claws can be freely extended or contracted. They have the power to punch right through a steel slab.

AROMATISSE.dex_entry: The scent that constantly emits from its fur is so powerful that this Pokémon's companions will eventually lose their sense of smell.

ARON.dex_entry: This Pokémon has a body of steel. To make its body, Aron feeds on iron ore that it digs from mountains. Occasionally, it causes major trouble by eating bridges and rails.

ARROKUDA.dex_entry: If it sees any movement around it, this Pokémon charges for it straightaway, leading with its sharply pointed jaw. It's very proud of that jaw.

ARTICUNO.dex_entry: Articuno is a legendary bird Pokémon that can control ice. The flapping of its wings chills the air. As a result, it is said that when this Pokémon flies, snow will fall.

AUDINO.dex_entry: Using the feelers on its ears, it can tell how someone is feeling or when an egg might hatch.

AURORUS.dex_entry: The diamond-shaped crystals on its body expel air as cold as -240 degrees Fahrenheit, surrounding its enemies and encasing them in ice.

AVALUGG.dex_entry: At high latitudes, this Pokémon can be found with clusters of Bergmite on its back as it swims among the icebergs.

AXEW.dex_entry: These Pokémon nest in the ground and use their tusks to crush hard berries. Crushing berries is also how they test each other's strength.

AZELF.dex_entry: Known as The Being of Willpower. It sleeps at the bottom of a lake to keep the world in balance.

AZUMARILL.dex_entry: It spends most of its time in the water. On sunny days, Azumarill floats on the surface of the water and sunbathes.

AZURILL.dex_entry: The ball on Azurill's tail bounces like a rubber ball, and it's full of the nutrients the Pokémon needs to grow.

BAGON.dex_entry: Its belief that it will be able to fly one day is apparently the influence of information carried in its genes.

BALTOY.dex_entry: It moves while spinning around on its single foot. Some Baltoy have been seen spinning on their heads.

BANETTE.dex_entry: Banette generates energy for laying strong curses by sticking pins into its own body. This Pokémon was originally a pitiful plush doll that was thrown away.

BARBARACLE.dex_entry: Seven Binacle come together to form one Barbaracle. The Binacle that serves as the head gives orders to those serving as the limbs.

BARBOACH.dex_entry: Its slimy body is hard to grasp. In one region, it is said to have been born from hardened mud.

BARRASKEWDA.dex_entry: This Pokémon has a jaw that's as sharp as a spear and as strong as steel. Apparently Barraskewda's flesh is surprisingly tasty, too.

BASCULIN.dex_entry: Anglers love the fight this Pokémon puts up on the hook. And there are always more to catch many people release them into lakes illicitly.

BASTIODON.dex_entry: While it can guard against any sort of attack from the front, it is left without recourse when attacked from behind.

BAYLEEF.dex_entry: Bayleef's neck is ringed by curled-up leaves. Inside each tubular leaf is a small shoot of a tree. The fragrance of this shoot makes people peppy.

BEARTIC.dex_entry: It swims through frigid seas, searching for prey. From its frozen breath, it forms icy fangs that are harder than steel.

BEAUTIFLY.dex_entry: Beautifly's favorite food is the sweet pollen of flowers. If you want to see this Pokémon, just leave a potted flower by an open window. Beautifly is sure to come looking for pollen.

BEEDRILL.dex_entry: Beedrill is extremely territorial. No one should ever approach its nestthis is for their own safety. If angered, they will attack in a furious swarm.

BEHEEYEM.dex_entry: Whenever a Beheeyem visits a farm, a Dubwool mysteriously disappears.

BELDUM.dex_entry: Its cells are all magnets. It uses magnetism to communicate with others of its kind.

BELLOSSOM.dex_entry: Plentiful in the tropics. When it dances, its petals rub together and make a pleasant ringing sound.

BELLSPROUT.dex_entry: Bellsprout's thin and flexible body lets it bend and sway to avoid any attack, however strong it may be. From its mouth, this Pokémon spits a corrosive fluid that melts even iron.

BERGMITE.dex_entry: They chill the air around them to -150 degrees Fahrenheit, freezing the water in the air into ice that they use as armor.

BEWEAR.dex_entry: Once it accepts you as a friend, it tries to show its affection with a hug. Letting it do that is dangerousit could easily shatter your bones.

BIBAREL.dex_entry: It busily makes its nest with stacks of branches and roots it has cut up with its sharp incisors.

BIDOOF.dex_entry: With nerves of steel, nothing can perturb it. It is more agile and active than it appears.

BINACLE.dex_entry: After two Binacle find a suitably sized rock, they adhere themselves to it and live together. They cooperate to gather food during high tide.

BISHARP.dex_entry: It's accompanied by a large retinue of Pawniard. Bisharp keeps a keen eye on its minions, ensuring none of them even think of double-crossing it.

BLASTOISE.dex_entry: It crushes its foe under its heavy body to cause fainting. In a pinch, it will withdraw inside its shell.

BLAZIKEN.dex_entry: In battle, Blaziken blows out intense flames from its wrists and attacks foes courageously. The stronger the foe, the more intensely this Pokémon's wrists burn.

BLIPBUG.dex_entry: A constant collector of information, this Pokémon is very smart. Very strong is what it isn't.

BLISSEY.dex_entry: Whenever a Blissey finds a weakened Pokémon, it will share its egg and offer its care until the other Pokémon is all better.

BLITZLE.dex_entry: When thunderclouds cover the sky, it will appear. It can catch lightning with its mane and store the electricity.

BOLDORE.dex_entry: If you see its orange crystals start to glow, be wary. It's about to fire off bursts of energy.

BOLTUND.dex_entry: This Pokémon generates electricity and channels it into its legs to keep them going strong. Boltund can run nonstop for three full days.

BONSLY.dex_entry: It expels both sweat and tears from its eyes. The sweat is a little salty, while the tears have a slight bitterness.

BOUFFALANT.dex_entry: These Pokémon can crush a car with no more than a headbutt. Bouffalant with more hair on their heads hold higher positions within the herd.

BOUNSWEET.dex_entry: Its body gives off a sweet, fruity scent that is extremely appetizing to bird Pokémon.

BRAIXEN.dex_entry: It has a twig stuck in its tail. With friction from its tail fur, it sets the twig on fire and launches into battle.

BRAVIARY.dex_entry: Known for its bravery and pride, this majestic Pokémon is often seen as a motif for various kinds of emblems.

BRELOOM.dex_entry: Breloom closes in on its foe with light and sprightly footwork, then throws punches with its stretchy arms. This Pokémon's fighting technique puts boxers to shame.

BRIONNE.dex_entry: As if dancing, it artfully dodges the attacks of its enemies. All the while, it's busy forming a bunch of balloons to overwhelm its foes.

BRONZONG.dex_entry: Some believe it to be a deity that summons rain clouds. When angered, it lets out a warning cry that rings out like the tolling of a bell.

BRONZOR.dex_entry: It appears in ancient ruins. The pattern on its body doesn't come from any culture in the Galar region, so it remains shrouded in mystery.

BRUXISH.dex_entry: When it unleashes its psychic power from the protuberance on its head, the grating sound of grinding teeth echoes through the area.

BUDEW.dex_entry: The pollen it releases contains poison. If this Pokémon is raised on clean water, the poison's toxicity is increased.

BUIZEL.dex_entry: It swims by rotating its two tails like a screw. When it dives, its flotation sac collapses.

BULBASAUR.dex_entry: There is a plant seed on its back right from the day this Pokémon is born. The seed slowly grows larger.

BUNEARY.dex_entry: If both of Buneary's ears are rolled up, something is wrong with its body or mind. It's a sure sign the Pokémon is in need of care.

BUNNELBY.dex_entry: It excels at digging holes. Using its ears, it can dig a nest 33 feet deep in one night.

BURMY_PLANT.dex_entry: To shelter itself from cold, wintry winds, it covers itself with a cloak made of twigs and leaves.

BURMY_SAND.dex_entry: To shelter itself from cold, wintry winds, it covers itself with a cloak made of twigs and leaves.

BURMY_TRASH.dex_entry: To shelter itself from cold, wintry winds, it covers itself with a cloak made of twigs and leaves.

BUTTERFREE.dex_entry: Crystallized Gigantamax energy makes up this Pokémon's blindingly bright and highly toxic scales.

BUZZWOLE.dex_entry: This Ultra Beast appeared from another world. It shows off its body, but whether that display is a boast or a threat remains unclear.

CACNEA.dex_entry: Cacnea lives in arid locations such as deserts. It releases a strong aroma from its flower to attract prey. When prey comes near, this Pokémon shoots sharp thorns from its body to bring the victim down.

CACTURNE.dex_entry: During the daytime, Cacturne remains unmoving so that it does not lose any moisture to the harsh desert sun. This Pokémon becomes active at night when the temperature drops.

CALYREX.dex_entry: Calyrex is a merciful Pokémon, capable of providing healing and blessings. It reigned over the Galar region in times of yore.

CAMERUPT.dex_entry: Camerupt has a volcano inside its body. Magma of 18,000 degrees Fahrenheit courses through its body. Occasionally, the humps on this Pokémon's back erupt, spewing the superheated magma.

CARBINK.dex_entry: Born from the high temperatures and pressures deep underground, it defends itself by firing beams from the jewel part of its body.

CARKOL.dex_entry: It forms coal inside its body. Coal dropped by this Pokémon once helped fuel the lives of people in the Galar region.

CARNIVINE.dex_entry: It attracts prey with its sweet-smelling saliva, then chomps down. It takes a whole day to eat prey.

CARRACOSTA.dex_entry: It constructed its sturdy shell by crunching and swallowing the hard shells or bones of its prey.

CARVANHA.dex_entry: It won't attack while it's alonenot even if it spots prey. Instead, it waits for other Carvanha to join it, and then the Pokémon attack as a group.

CASCOON.dex_entry: Cascoon makes its protective cocoon by wrapping its body entirely with a fine silk from its mouth. Once the silk goes around its body, it hardens. This Pokémon prepares for its evolution inside the cocoon.

CASTFORM.dex_entry: It changes its form depending on the weather. Changes in the temperature or humidity appear to affect its cellular structure.

CATERPIE.dex_entry: For protection, it releases a horrible stench from the antenna on its head to drive away enemies.

CELEBI.dex_entry: This Pokémon has the ability to move through time. Records describing it as a forest deity can be found from many different eras.

CELESTEELA.dex_entry: It appeared from the Ultra Wormhole. Witnesses observed it flying across the sky at high speed.

CENTISKORCH.dex_entry: Gigantamax energy has evoked a rise in its body temperature, now reaching over 1,800 degrees Fahrenheit. Its heat waves incinerate its enemies.

CHANDELURE.dex_entry: This Pokémon haunts dilapidated mansions. It sways its arms to hypnotize opponents with the ominous dancing of its flames.

CHANSEY.dex_entry: The egg Chansey carries is not only delicious but also packed with nutrition. It's used as a high-class cooking ingredient.

CHARIZARD.dex_entry: It spits fire that is hot enough to melt boulders. It may cause forest fires by blowing flames.

CHARJABUG.dex_entry: While its durable shell protects it from attacks, Charjabug strikes at enemies with jolts of electricity discharged from the tips of its jaws.

CHARMANDER.dex_entry: It has a preference for hot things. When it rains, steam is said to spout from the tip of its tail.

CHARMELEON.dex_entry: It has a barbaric nature. In battle, it whips its fiery tail around and slashes away with sharp claws.

CHATOT.dex_entry: It mimics the cries of other Pokémon to trick them into thinking it's one of them. This way they won't attack it.

CHERRIM.dex_entry: After absorbing plenty of sunlight, Cherrim takes this form. It's full of energy while it's like this, and its liveliness will go on until sundown.

CHERUBI.dex_entry: It nimbly dashes about to avoid getting pecked by bird Pokémon that would love to make off with its small, nutrient-rich storage ball.

CHESNAUGHT.dex_entry: Its Tackle is forceful enough to flip a 50-ton tank. It shields its allies from danger with its own body.

CHESPIN.dex_entry: The quills on its head are usually soft. When it flexes them, the points become so hard and sharp that they can pierce rock.

CHEWTLE.dex_entry: Apparently the itch of its teething impels it to snap its jaws at anything in front of it.

CHIKORITA.dex_entry: In battle, Chikorita waves its leaf around to keep the foe at bay. However, a sweet fragrance also wafts from the leaf, becalming the battling Pokémon and creating a cozy, friendly atmosphere all around.

CHIMCHAR.dex_entry: Its fiery rear end is fueled by gas made in its belly. Even rain can't extinguish the fire.

CHIMECHO.dex_entry: Chimecho makes its cries echo inside its hollow body. When this Pokémon becomes enraged, its cries result in ultrasonic waves that have the power to knock foes flying.

CHINCHOU.dex_entry: Its antennae, which evolved from a fin, have both positive and negative charges flowing through them.

CHINGLING.dex_entry: Each time it hops, it makes a ringing sound. It deafens foes by emitting high-frequency cries.

CINCCINO.dex_entry: Its body secretes oil that this Pokémon spreads over its nest as a coating to protect it from dust. Cinccino won't tolerate even a speck of the stuff.

CINDERACE.dex_entry: Infused with Cinderace's fighting spirit, the gigantic Pyro Ball never misses its targets and completely roasts opponents.

CLAMPERL.dex_entry: Clamperl's sturdy shell is not only good for protectionit is also used for clamping and catching prey. A fully grown Clamperl's shell will be scored with nicks and scratches all over.

CLAUNCHER.dex_entry: Clauncher's claws can fall off during battle, but they'll regenerate. The meat inside the claws is popular as a delicacy in Galar.

CLAWITZER.dex_entry: After using the feelers on its oversized claw to detect the location of prey, Clawitzer launches a cannonball of water at its target.

CLAYDOL.dex_entry: This mysterious Pokémon started life as an ancient clay figurine made over 20,000 years ago.

CLEFABLE.dex_entry: A timid fairy Pokémon that is rarely seen, it will run and hide the moment it senses people.

CLEFAIRY.dex_entry: It is said that happiness will come to those who see a gathering of Clefairy dancing under a full moon.

CLEFFA.dex_entry: According to local rumors, Cleffa are often seen in places where shooting stars have fallen.

CLOBBOPUS.dex_entry: It's very curious, but its means of investigating things is to try to punch them with its tentacles. The search for food is what brings it onto land.

CLOYSTER.dex_entry: Its shell is extremely hard. It cannot be shattered, even with a bomb. The shell opens only when it is attacking.

COALOSSAL.dex_entry: Its body is a colossal stove. With Gigantamax energy stoking the fire, this Pokémon's flame burns hotter than 3,600 degrees Fahrenheit.

COBALION.dex_entry: It has a body and heart of steel. Its glare is sufficient to make even an unruly Pokémon obey it.

COFAGRIGUS.dex_entry: This Pokémon has a body of sparkling gold. People say it no longer remembers that it was once human.

COMBEE.dex_entry: The members of the trio spend all their time together. Each one has a slightly different taste in nectar.

COMBUSKEN.dex_entry: Combusken toughens up its legs and thighs by running through fields and mountains. This Pokémon's legs possess both speed and power, enabling it to dole out 10 kicks in one second.

COMFEY.dex_entry: Comfey picks flowers with its vine and decorates itself with them. For some reason, flowers won't wither once they're attached to a Comfey.

CONKELDURR.dex_entry: Concrete mixed by Conkeldurr is much more durable than normal concrete, even when the compositions of the two materials are the same.

COPPERAJAH.dex_entry: So much power is packed within its trunk that if it were to unleash that power, the resulting blast could level mountains and change the landscape.

CORPHISH.dex_entry: No matter how dirty the water in the river, it will adapt and thrive. It has a strong will to survive.

CORSOLA.dex_entry: It will regrow any branches that break off its head. People keep particularly beautiful Corsola branches as charms to promote safe childbirth.

CORSOLA_GALARIAN.dex_entry: It will regrow any branches that break off its head. People keep particularly beautiful Corsola branches as charms to promote safe childbirth.

CORVIKNIGHT.dex_entry: Imbued with Gigantamax energy, its wings can whip up winds more forceful than any a hurricane could muster. The gusts blow everything away.

CORVISQUIRE.dex_entry: Smart enough to use tools in battle, these Pokémon have been seen picking up rocks and flinging them or using ropes to wrap up enemies.

COSMOEM.dex_entry: The absorption of starlight fuels this Pokémon's growth. The shell that encases it is harder than any known material.

COSMOG.dex_entry: This Pokémon came from another universe. Its gaseous body is so light that even a gentle breeze can blow it away.

COTTONEE.dex_entry: It shoots cotton from its body to protect itself. If it gets caught up in hurricane-strength winds, it can get sent to the other side of the Earth.

CRABOMINABLE.dex_entry: It aimed for the top but got lost and ended up on a snowy mountain. Being forced to endure the cold, this Pokémon evolved and grew fur.

CRABRAWLER.dex_entry: While guarding its weak points with its pincers, it looks for an opening and unleashes punches. When it loses, it foams at the mouth and faints.

CRADILY.dex_entry: Cradily roams around the ocean floor in search of food. This Pokémon freely extends its tree trunk-like neck and captures unwary prey using its eight tentacles.

CRAMORANT.dex_entry: Cramorant's gluttony led it to try to swallow an Arrokuda whole, which in turn led to Cramorant getting an Arrokuda stuck in its throat.

CRANIDOS.dex_entry: It lived in jungles around a hundred million years ago. It used its skillful headbutts to combat Aerodactyl.

CRAWDAUNT.dex_entry: A rough customer that wildly flails its giant claws. It is said to be extremely hard to raise.

CRESSELIA.dex_entry: Shiny particles are released from its wings like a veil. It is said to represent the crescent moon.

CROAGUNK.dex_entry: It makes frightening noises with its poison-filled cheek sacs. When opponents flinch, Croagunk hits them with a poison jab.

CROBAT.dex_entry: Both its legs became wings, and as a result, it can't move well on the ground. All it can do is crawl around.

CROCONAW.dex_entry: Once Croconaw has clamped its jaws on its foe, it will absolutely not let go. Because the tips of its fangs are forked back like barbed fishhooks, they become impossible to remove when they have sunk in.

CRUSTLE.dex_entry: This highly territorial Pokémon prefers dry climates. It won't come out of its boulder on rainy days.

CRYOGONAL.dex_entry: They are born in snow clouds. They use chains made of ice crystals to capture prey.

CUBCHOO.dex_entry: When this Pokémon is in good health, its snot becomes thicker and stickier. It will smear its snot on anyone it doesn't like.

CUBONE.dex_entry: When the memory of its departed mother brings it to tears, its cries echo mournfully within the skull it wears on its head.

CUFANT.dex_entry: It digs up the ground with its trunk. It's also very strong, being able to carry loads of over five tons without any problem at all.

CURSOLA.dex_entry: Its shell is overflowing with its heightened otherworldly energy. The ectoplasm serves as protection for this Pokémon's core spirit.

CUTIEFLY.dex_entry: Nectar and pollen are its favorite fare. You can find Cutiefly hovering around Gossifleur, trying to get some of Gossifleur's pollen.

CYNDAQUIL.dex_entry: Cyndaquil protects itself by flaring up the flames on its back. The flames are vigorous if the Pokémon is angry. However, if it is tired, the flames splutter fitfully with incomplete combustion.

DARKRAI.dex_entry: It chases people and Pokémon from its territory by causing them to experience deep, nightmarish slumbers.

DARMANITAN.dex_entry: Anger has reignited its atrophied flame sac. This Pokémon spews fire everywhere as it rampages indiscriminately.

DARMANITAN_GALARIAN.dex_entry: Anger has reignited its atrophied flame sac. This Pokémon spews fire everywhere as it rampages indiscriminately.

DARMANITAN_GALARIAN_ZENMODE.dex_entry: Anger has reignited its atrophied flame sac. This Pokémon spews fire everywhere as it rampages indiscriminately.

DARMANITAN_ZENMODE.dex_entry: Anger has reignited its atrophied flame sac. This Pokémon spews fire everywhere as it rampages indiscriminately.

DARTRIX.dex_entry: It throws one knifelike feather after another at its enemies, and each one precisely strikes a weak point. These feathers are known as blade quills.

DARUMAKA.dex_entry: It derives its power from fire burning inside its body. If the fire dwindles, this Pokémon will immediately fall asleep.

DARUMAKA_GALARIAN.dex_entry: It derives its power from fire burning inside its body. If the fire dwindles, this Pokémon will immediately fall asleep.

DECIDUEYE.dex_entry: As if wielding a bow, it launches the arrow quills hidden among the feathers of its wings. Decidueye's shots never miss.

DECIDUEYE_HISUIAN.dex_entry: As if wielding a bow, it launches the arrow quills hidden among the feathers of its wings. Decidueye's shots never miss.

DEDENNE.dex_entry: A Dedenne's whiskers pick up electrical waves other Dedenne send out. These Pokémon share locations of food or electricity with one another.

DEERLING.dex_entry: Their coloring changes according to the seasons and can be slightly affected by the temperature and humidity as well.

DEINO.dex_entry: When it encounters something, its first urge is usually to bite it. If it likes what it tastes, it will commit the associated scent to memory.

DELCATTY.dex_entry: Delcatty prefers to live an unfettered existence in which it can do as it pleases at its own pace. Because this Pokémon eats and sleeps whenever it decides, its daily routines are completely random.

DELIBIRD.dex_entry: It carries food all day long. There are tales about lost people who were saved by the food it had.

DELPHOX.dex_entry: It gazes into the flame at the tip of its branch to achieve a focused state, which allows it to see into the future.

DEOXYS_ATTACK.dex_entry: The DNA of a space virus underwent a sudden mutation upon exposure to a laser beam and resulted in Deoxys. The crystalline organ on this Pokémon's chest appears to be its brain.

DEOXYS_DEFENSE.dex_entry: The DNA of a space virus underwent a sudden mutation upon exposure to a laser beam and resulted in Deoxys. The crystalline organ on this Pokémon's chest appears to be its brain.

DEOXYS_NORMAL.dex_entry: The DNA of a space virus underwent a sudden mutation upon exposure to a laser beam and resulted in Deoxys. The crystalline organ on this Pokémon's chest appears to be its brain.

DEOXYS_SPEED.dex_entry: The DNA of a space virus underwent a sudden mutation upon exposure to a laser beam and resulted in Deoxys. The crystalline organ on this Pokémon's chest appears to be its brain.

DEWGONG.dex_entry: Dewgong loves to snooze on bitterly cold ice. The sight of this Pokémon sleeping on a glacier was mistakenly thought to be a mermaid by a mariner long ago.

DEWOTT.dex_entry: Strict training is how it learns its flowing double-scalchop technique.

DEWPIDER.dex_entry: It forms a water bubble at the rear of its body and then covers its head with it. Meeting another Dewpider means comparing water-bubble sizes.

DHELMISE.dex_entry: After a piece of seaweed merged with debris from a sunken ship, it was reborn as this ghost Pokémon.

DIALGA.dex_entry: A Pokémon spoken of in legend. It is said that time began moving when Dialga was born.

DIANCIE.dex_entry: A sudden transformation of Carbink, its pink, glimmering body is said to be the loveliest sight in the whole world.

DIGGERSBY.dex_entry: With power equal to an excavator, it can dig through dense bedrock. It's a huge help during tunnel construction.

DIGLETT.dex_entry: If a Diglett digs through a field, it leaves the soil perfectly tilled and ideal for planting crops.

DITTO.dex_entry: It can reconstitute its entire cellular structure to change into what it sees, but it returns to normal when it relaxes.

DODRIO.dex_entry: Watch out if Dodrio's three heads are looking in three separate directions. It's a sure sign that it is on its guard. Don't go near this Pokémon if it's being waryit may decide to peck you.

DODUO.dex_entry: Doduo's two heads never sleep at the same time. Its two heads take turns sleeping, so one head can always keep watch for enemies while the other one sleeps.

DONPHAN.dex_entry: Donphan's favorite attack is curling its body into a ball, then charging at its foe while rolling at high speed. Once it starts rolling, this Pokémon can't stop very easily.

DOTTLER.dex_entry: It barely moves, but it's still alive. Hiding in its shell without food or water seems to have awakened its psychic powers.

DOUBLADE.dex_entry: Honedge evolves into twins. The two blades rub together to emit a metallic sound that unnerves opponents.

DRACOVISH.dex_entry: Powerful legs and jaws made it the apex predator of its time. Its own overhunting of its prey was what drove it to extinction.

DRACOZOLT.dex_entry: In ancient times, it was unbeatable thanks to its powerful lower body, but it went extinct anyway after it depleted all its plant-based food sources.

DRAGALGE.dex_entry: Dragalge uses a poisonous liquid capable of corroding metal to send tankers that enter its territory to the bottom of the sea.

DRAGAPULT.dex_entry: When it isn't battling, it keeps Dreepy in the holes on its horns. Once a fight starts, it launches the Dreepy like supersonic missiles.

DRAGONAIR.dex_entry: It has long been thought that its crystalline orbs are imbued with the power to control the weather.

DRAGONITE.dex_entry: This Pokémon saved a shipwrecked man, taking him to a remote islanda paradise occupied solely by Dragonite.

DRAKLOAK.dex_entry: It's capable of flying faster than 120 mph. It battles alongside Dreepy and dotes on them until they successfully evolve.

DRAMPA.dex_entry: The mountains it calls home are nearly two miles in height. On rare occasions, it descends to play with the children living in the towns below.

DRAPION.dex_entry: Its poison is potent, but it rarely sees use. This Pokémon prefers to use physical force instead, going on rampages with its car-crushing strength.

DRATINI.dex_entry: It grows by molting repeatedly. Boots made from the tanned cast-off skin are a super luxury item.

DREDNAW.dex_entry: It responded to Gigantamax energy by becoming bipedal. First it comes crashing down on foes, and then it finishes them off with its massive jaws.

DREEPY.dex_entry: After being reborn as a ghost Pokémon, Dreepy wanders the areas it used to inhabit back when it was alive in prehistoric seas.

DRIFBLIM.dex_entry: Some say this Pokémon is a collection of souls burdened with regrets, silently drifting through the dusk.

DRIFLOON.dex_entry: Perhaps seeking company, it approaches children. However, it often quickly runs away again when the children play too roughly with it.

DRILBUR.dex_entry: It brings its claws together and whirls around at high speed before rushing toward its prey.

DRIZZILE.dex_entry: A clever combatant, this Pokémon battles using water balloons created with moisture secreted from its palms.

DROWZEE.dex_entry: A Pokémon that nourishes itself by eating dreams, it is thought to share common ancestry with Munna and Musharna.

DRUDDIGON.dex_entry: Druddigon lives in caves, but it never skips sunbathingit won't be able to move if its body gets too cold.

DUBWOOL.dex_entry: Weave a carpet from its springy wool, and you end up with something closer to a trampoline. You'll start to bounce the moment you set foot on it.

DUCKLETT.dex_entry: When attacked, it uses its feathers to splash water, escaping under cover of the spray.

DUGTRIO.dex_entry: A team of Diglett triplets. It triggers huge earthquakes by burrowing 60 miles underground.

DUNSPARCE.dex_entry: This Pokémon's tiny wings have some scientists saying that Dunsparce used to fly through the sky in ancient times.

DUOSION.dex_entry: Its psychic power can supposedly cover a range of more than half a milebut only if its two brains can agree with each other.

DURALUDON.dex_entry: Its body resembles polished metal, and it's both lightweight and strong. The only drawback is that it rusts easily.

DURANT.dex_entry: They lay their eggs deep inside their nests. When attacked by Heatmor, they retaliate using their massive mandibles.

DUSCLOPS.dex_entry: Its body is entirely hollow. When it opens its mouth, it sucks everything in as if it were a black hole.

DUSKNOIR.dex_entry: At the bidding of transmissions from the spirit world, it steals people and Pokémon away. No one knows whether it has a will of its own.

DUSKULL.dex_entry: If it finds bad children who won't listen to their parents, it will spirit them awayor so it's said.

DUSTOX.dex_entry: Dustox is instinctively drawn to light. Swarms of this Pokémon are attracted by the bright lights of cities, where they wreak havoc by stripping the leaves off roadside trees for food.

DWEBBLE.dex_entry: When it finds a stone appealing, it creates a hole inside it and uses it as its home. This Pokémon is the natural enemy of Roggenrola and Rolycoly.

EELEKTRIK.dex_entry: It wraps itself around its prey and paralyzes it with electricity from the round spots on its sides. Then it chomps.

EELEKTROSS.dex_entry: With their sucker mouths, they suck in prey. Then they use their fangs to shock the prey with electricity.

EEVEE.dex_entry: Gigantamax energy upped the fluffiness of the fur around Eevee's neck. The fur will envelop a foe, capturing its body and captivating its mind.

EISCUE.dex_entry: It drifted in on the flow of ocean waters from a frigid place. It keeps its head iced constantly to make sure it stays nice and cold.

EKANS.dex_entry: Ekans curls itself up in a spiral while it rests. Assuming this position allows it to quickly respond to a threat from any direction with a glare from its upraised head.

ELDEGOSS.dex_entry: The seeds attached to its cotton fluff are full of nutrients. It spreads them on the wind so that plants and other Pokémon can benefit from them.

ELECTABUZZ.dex_entry: Half of all sudden blackouts are caused by Electabuzz gathering at electric power plants and gobbling up electricity.

ELECTIVIRE.dex_entry: It pushes the tips of its tails against its foes and then lets loose a high-voltage current. Its foes are burned to a crisp in an instant.

ELECTRIKE.dex_entry: It stores static electricity in its fur for discharging. It gives off sparks if a storm approaches.

ELECTRODE.dex_entry: Electrode eats electricity in the atmosphere. On days when lightning strikes, you can see this Pokémon exploding all over the place from eating too much electricity.

ELECTRODE_HISUIAN.dex_entry: Electrode eats electricity in the atmosphere. On days when lightning strikes, you can see this Pokémon exploding all over the place from eating too much electricity.

ELEKID.dex_entry: When it's in a house, electrical outlets serve as its baby bottles. It sucks down electricity.

ELGYEM.dex_entry: If this Pokémon stands near a TV, strange scenery will appear on the screen. That scenery is said to be from its home.

EMBOAR.dex_entry: It can throw a fire punch by setting its fists on fire with its fiery chin. It cares deeply about its friends.

EMOLGA.dex_entry: As Emolga flutters through the air, it crackles with electricity. This Pokémon is cute, but it can cause a lot of trouble.

EMPOLEON.dex_entry: It swims as fast as a jet boat. The edges of its wings are sharp and can slice apart drifting ice.

ENTEI.dex_entry: Entei embodies the passion of magma. This Pokémon is thought to have been born in the eruption of a volcano. It sends up massive bursts of fire that utterly consume all that they touch.

ESCAVALIER.dex_entry: They use shells they've stolen from Shelmet to arm and protect themselves. They're very popular Pokémon in the Galar region.

ESPEON.dex_entry: By reading air currents, it can predict things such as the weather or its foe's next move.

ESPURR.dex_entry: Though Espurr's expression never changes, behind that blank stare is an intense struggle to contain its devastating psychic power.

ETERNATUS.dex_entry: As a result of Rose's meddling, Eternatus absorbed all the energy in the Galar region. It's now in a state of power overload.

EXCADRILL.dex_entry: It's not uncommon for tunnels that appear to have formed naturally to actually be a result of Excadrill's rampant digging.

EXEGGCUTE.dex_entry: Though it may look like it's just a bunch of eggs, it's a proper Pokémon. Exeggcute communicates with others of its kind via telepathy, apparently.

EXEGGUTOR.dex_entry: Each of Exeggutor's three heads is thinking different thoughts. The three don't seem to be very interested in one another.

EXEGGUTOR_ALOLAN.dex_entry: Each of Exeggutor's three heads is thinking different thoughts. The three don't seem to be very interested in one another.

EXPLOUD.dex_entry: In the past, people would use the loud voices of these Pokémon as a means of communication between distant cities.

FALINKS.dex_entry: Five of them are troopers, and one is the brass. The brass's orders are absolute.

FARFETCH_D.dex_entry: The Farfetch'd of the Galar region are brave warriors, and they wield thick, tough leeks in battle.

FARFETCH_D_GALARIAN.dex_entry: The Farfetch'd of the Galar region are brave warriors, and they wield thick, tough leeks in battle.

FEAROW.dex_entry: It's tough and has excellent stamina. It has no problem flying continuously for a whole day carrying a heavy load.

FEEBAS.dex_entry: Although unattractive and unpopular, this Pokémon's marvelous vitality has made it a subject of research.

FENNEKIN.dex_entry: Eating a twig fills it with energy, and its roomy ears give vent to air hotter than 390 degrees Fahrenheit.

FERALIGATR.dex_entry: Feraligatr intimidates its foes by opening its huge mouth. In battle, it will kick the ground hard with its thick and powerful hind legs to charge at the foe at an incredible speed.

FERROSEED.dex_entry: It defends itself by launching spikes, but its aim isn't very good at first. Only after a lot of practice will it improve.

FERROTHORN.dex_entry: This Pokémon scrapes its spikes across rocks, and then uses the tips of its feelers to absorb the nutrients it finds within the stone.

FINNEON.dex_entry: It absorbs sunlight with the pink areas of its skin, which then shine. This appears to be a form of camouflage.

FLAAFFY.dex_entry: Flaaffy's wool quality changes so that it can generate a high amount of static electricity with a small amount of wool. The bare and slick parts of its hide are shielded against electricity.

FLABEBE_BLUE.dex_entry: It draws out and controls the hidden power of flowers. The flower Flabébé holds is most likely part of its body.

FLABEBE_ORANGE.dex_entry: It draws out and controls the hidden power of flowers. The flower Flabébé holds is most likely part of its body.

FLABEBE_RED.dex_entry: It draws out and controls the hidden power of flowers. The flower Flabébé holds is most likely part of its body.

FLABEBE_WHITE.dex_entry: It draws out and controls the hidden power of flowers. The flower Flabébé holds is most likely part of its body.

FLABEBE_YELLOW.dex_entry: It draws out and controls the hidden power of flowers. The flower Flabébé holds is most likely part of its body.

FLAPPLE.dex_entry: It ate a sour apple, and that induced its evolution. In its cheeks, it stores an acid capable of causing chemical burns.

FLAREON.dex_entry: Once it has stored up enough heat, this Pokémon's body temperature can reach up to 1,700 degrees Fahrenheit.

FLETCHINDER.dex_entry: Fletchinder launches embers into the den of its prey. When the prey comes leaping out, Fletchinder's sharp talons finish it off.

FLETCHLING.dex_entry: Its melodious cries are actually warnings. Fletchling will mercilessly peck at anything that enters its territory.

FLOATZEL.dex_entry: It floats using its well-developed flotation sac. It assists in the rescues of drowning people.

FLOETTE_BLUE.dex_entry: It flutters around fields of flowers and cares for flowers that are starting to wilt. It draws out the hidden power of flowers to battle.

FLOETTE_ORANGE.dex_entry: It flutters around fields of flowers and cares for flowers that are starting to wilt. It draws out the hidden power of flowers to battle.

FLOETTE_RED.dex_entry: It flutters around fields of flowers and cares for flowers that are starting to wilt. It draws out the hidden power of flowers to battle.

FLOETTE_WHITE.dex_entry: It flutters around fields of flowers and cares for flowers that are starting to wilt. It draws out the hidden power of flowers to battle.

FLOETTE_YELLOW.dex_entry: It flutters around fields of flowers and cares for flowers that are starting to wilt. It draws out the hidden power of flowers to battle.

FLORGES_BLUE.dex_entry: It claims exquisite flower gardens as its territory, and it obtains power from basking in the energy emitted by flowering plants.

FLORGES_ORANGE.dex_entry: It claims exquisite flower gardens as its territory, and it obtains power from basking in the energy emitted by flowering plants.

FLORGES_RED.dex_entry: It claims exquisite flower gardens as its territory, and it obtains power from basking in the energy emitted by flowering plants.

FLORGES_WHITE.dex_entry: It claims exquisite flower gardens as its territory, and it obtains power from basking in the energy emitted by flowering plants.

FLORGES_YELLOW.dex_entry: It claims exquisite flower gardens as its territory, and it obtains power from basking in the energy emitted by flowering plants.

FLYGON.dex_entry: This Pokémon hides in the heart of sandstorms it creates and seldom appears where people can see it.

FOMANTIS.dex_entry: When bathed in sunlight, this Pokémon emits a pleasantly sweet scent, which causes bug Pokémon to gather around it.

FOONGUS.dex_entry: No one knows what the Poké Balllike pattern on Foongus means or why Foongus has it.

FORRETRESS.dex_entry: Forretress conceals itself inside its hardened steel shell. The shell is opened when the Pokémon is catching prey, but it does so at such a quick pace that the shell's inside cannot be seen.

FRAXURE.dex_entry: After battle, this Pokémon carefully sharpens its tusks on river rocks. It needs to take care of its tusksif one breaks, it will never grow back.

FRILLISH.dex_entry: It envelops its prey in its veillike arms and draws it down to the deeps, five miles below the ocean's surface.

FROAKIE.dex_entry: It secretes flexible bubbles from its chest and back. The bubbles reduce the damage it would otherwise take when attacked.

FROGADIER.dex_entry: It can throw bubble-covered pebbles with precise control, hitting empty cans up to a hundred feet away.

FROSLASS.dex_entry: After a woman met her end on a snowy mountain, her regrets lingered on. From them, this Pokémon was born. Its favorite food is frozen souls.

FROSMOTH.dex_entry: Icy scales fall from its wings like snow as it flies over fields and mountains. The temperature of its wings is less than -290 degrees Fahrenheit.

FURFROU.dex_entry: Trimming its fluffy fur not only makes it more elegant but also increases the swiftness of its movements.

FURRET.dex_entry: Furret has a very slim build. When under attack, it can slickly squirm through narrow spaces and get away. In spite of its short limbs, this Pokémon is very nimble and fleet.

GABITE.dex_entry: In rare cases, it molts and sheds its scales. Medicine containing its scales as an ingredient will make a weary body feel invigorated.

GALLADE.dex_entry: True to its honorable-warrior image, it uses the blades on its elbows only in defense of something or someone.

GALVANTULA.dex_entry: It launches electrified fur from its abdomen as its means of attack. Opponents hit by the fur could be in for three full days and nights of paralysis.

GARBODOR.dex_entry: Due to Gigantamax energy, this Pokémon's toxic gas has become much thicker, congealing into masses shaped like discarded toys.

GARCHOMP.dex_entry: It can fly at speeds rivaling jet planes. It dives into flocks of bird Pokémon and gulps the entire flock down whole.

GARDEVOIR.dex_entry: It has the power to predict the future. Its power peaks when it is protecting its Trainer.

GASTLY.dex_entry: Born from gases, anyone would faint if engulfed by its gaseous body, which contains poison.

GASTRODON.dex_entry: It secretes a purple fluid to deter enemies. This fluid isn't poisonousinstead, it's super sticky, and once it sticks, it's very hard to unstick.

GENESECT.dex_entry: This ancient bug Pokémon was altered by Team Plasma. They upgraded the cannon on its back.

GENGAR.dex_entry: On the night of a full moon, if shadows move on their own and laugh, it must be Gengar's doing.

GEODUDE.dex_entry: Its round body makes it easy to pick up, but it is hard and heavy. It's dangerous to play with them as if they were snowballs.

GIBLE.dex_entry: It lives in caves warmed by geothermal heat. Even so, when the weather gets cold, it will huddle close with others of its kind.

GIGALITH.dex_entry: This hardy Pokémon can often be found on construction sites and in mines, working alongside people and Copperajah.

GIRAFARIG.dex_entry: Girafarig's rear head also has a brain, but it is small. The rear head attacks in response to smells and sounds. Approaching this Pokémon from behind can cause the rear head to suddenly lash out and bite.

GIRATINA.dex_entry: This Pokémon is said to live in a world on the reverse side of ours, where common knowledge is distorted and strange.

GLACEON.dex_entry: Any who become captivated by the beauty of the snowfall that Glaceon creates will be frozen before they know it.

GLALIE.dex_entry: It has a body of ice that won't melt, even with fire. It can instantly freeze moisture in the atmosphere.

GLAMEOW.dex_entry: It claws if displeased and purrs when affectionate. Its fickleness is very popular among some.

GLASTRIER.dex_entry: Glastrier emits intense cold from its hooves. It's also a belligerent Pokémonanything it wants, it takes by force.

GLIGAR.dex_entry: Gligar glides through the air without a sound as if it were sliding. This Pokémon hangs on to the face of its foe using its clawed hind legs and the large pincers on its forelegs, then injects the prey with its poison barb.

GLISCOR.dex_entry: It observes prey while hanging inverted from branches. When the chance presents itself, it swoops!

GLOOM.dex_entry: Its pistils exude an incredibly foul odor. The horrid stench can cause fainting at a distance of 1.25 miles.

GMRMIME.dex_entry: Its talent is tap-dancing. It can also manipulate temperatures to create a floor of ice, which this Pokémon can kick up to use as a barrier.

GOGOAT.dex_entry: It can tell how its Trainer is feeling by subtle shifts in the grip on its horns. This empathic sense lets them run as if one being.

GOLBAT.dex_entry: Its thick fangs are hollow like straws, making them unexpectedly fragile. These fangs are specialized for sucking blood.

GOLDEEN.dex_entry: Its dorsal, pectoral, and tail fins wave elegantly in water. That is why it is known as the Water Dancer.

GOLDUCK.dex_entry: This Pokémon lives in gently flowing rivers. It paddles through the water with its long limbs, putting its graceful swimming skills on display.

GOLEM.dex_entry: Its body can survive dynamite blasts without a single scratch, but it hates rain and humidity.

GOLETT.dex_entry: They were sculpted from clay in ancient times. No one knows why, but some of them are driven to continually line up boulders.

GOLISOPOD.dex_entry: It will do anything to win, taking advantage of every opening and finishing opponents off with the small claws on its front legs.

GOLURK.dex_entry: Artillery platforms built into the walls of ancient castles served as perches from which Golurk could fire energy beams.

GOODRA.dex_entry: Sometimes it misunderstands instructions and appears dazed or bewildered. Many Trainers don't mind, finding this behavior to be adorable.

GOOMY.dex_entry: Because most of its body is water, it will dry up if the weather becomes too arid. It's considered the weakest dragon Pokémon.

GOREBYSS.dex_entry: Gorebyss lives in the southern seas at extreme depths. Its body is built to withstand the enormous pressure of water at incredible depths. Because of this, this Pokémon's body is unharmed by ordinary attacks.

GOSSIFLEUR.dex_entry: It anchors itself in the ground with its single leg, then basks in the sun. After absorbing enough sunlight, its petals spread as it blooms brilliantly.

GOTHITA.dex_entry: Though they're still only babies, there's psychic power stored in their ribbonlike feelers, and sometimes they use that power to fight.

GOTHITELLE.dex_entry: It has tremendous psychic power, but it dislikes conflict. It's also able to predict the future based on the movement of the stars.

GOTHORITA.dex_entry: It's said that when stars shine in the night sky, this Pokémon will spirit away sleeping children. Some call it the Witch of Punishment.

GOURGEIST.dex_entry: Eerie cries emanate from its body in the dead of night. The sounds are said to be the wails of spirits who are suffering in the afterlife.

GRANBULL.dex_entry: Its well-developed lower jaw and heavy fangs are its weapons. As long as it's not provoked, it rarely bites.

GRAPPLOCT.dex_entry: A body made up of nothing but muscle makes the grappling moves this Pokémon performs with its tentacles tremendously powerful.

GRAVELER.dex_entry: Mossy rocks are its favorite food. It can devour a ton a day while crunching loudly.

GREEDENT.dex_entry: It stashes berries in its tailso many berries that they fall out constantly. But this Pokémon is a bit slow-witted, so it doesn't notice the loss.

GRENINJA.dex_entry: It creates throwing stars out of compressed water. When it spins them and throws them at high speed, these stars can split metal in two.

GRIMER.dex_entry: Its main source of food is the slimy industrial waste of factories. This Pokémon's numbers have been decreasing in recent years.

GRIMER_ALOLAN.dex_entry: Its main source of food is the slimy industrial waste of factories. This Pokémon's numbers have been decreasing in recent years.

GRIMMSNARL.dex_entry: By transforming its leg hair, this Pokémon delivers power-packed drill kicks that can bore huge holes in Galar's terrain.

GROOKEY.dex_entry: When it uses its special stick to strike up a beat, the sound waves produced carry revitalizing energy to the plants and flowers in the area.

GROTLE.dex_entry: It lives along water in forests. In the daytime, it leaves the forest to sunbathe its treed shell.

GROUDON.dex_entry: Groudon is said to be the personification of the land itself. Legends tell of its many clashes against Kyogre, as each sought to gain the power of nature.

GROVYLE.dex_entry: The leaves growing out of Grovyle's body are convenient for camouflaging it from enemies in the forest. This Pokémon is a master at climbing trees in jungles.

GROWLITHE.dex_entry: It has a brave and trustworthy nature. It fearlessly stands up to bigger and stronger foes.

GROWLITHE_HISUIAN.dex_entry: It has a brave and trustworthy nature. It fearlessly stands up to bigger and stronger foes.

GRUBBIN.dex_entry: Its natural enemies, like Rookidee, may flee rather than risk getting caught in its large mandibles that can snap thick tree branches.

GRUMPIG.dex_entry: Grumpig uses the black pearls on its body to amplify its psychic power waves for gaining total control over its foe. When this Pokémon uses its special power, its snorting breath grows labored.

GULPIN.dex_entry: Virtually all of Gulpin's body is its stomach. As a result, it can swallow something its own size. This Pokémon's stomach contains a special fluid that digests anything.

GUMSHOOS.dex_entry: When it finds a trace of its prey, it patiently stakes out the location...but it's always snoozing by nightfall.

GURDURR.dex_entry: It shows off its muscles to Machoke and other Gurdurr. If it fails to measure up to the other Pokémon, it lies low for a little while.

GUZZLORD.dex_entry: It has gobbled mountains and swallowed whole buildings, according to reports. It's one of the Ultra Beasts.

GYARADOS.dex_entry: It has an extremely aggressive nature. The Hyper Beam it shoots from its mouth totally incinerates all targets.

HAKAMO-O.dex_entry: The scaleless, scarred parts of its body are signs of its strength. It shows them off to defeated opponents.

HAPPINY.dex_entry: Mimicking Chansey, Happiny will place an egg- shaped stone in its belly pouch. Happiny will treasure this stone.

HARIYAMA.dex_entry: It is known for its fantastic strength, but as it grows older, it focuses more on training Makuhita.

HATENNA.dex_entry: Via the protrusion on its head, it senses other creatures' emotions. If you don't have a calm disposition, it will never warm up to you.

HATTERENE.dex_entry: It emits psychic power strong enough to cause headaches as a deterrent to the approach of others.

HATTREM.dex_entry: No matter who you are, if you bring strong emotions near this Pokémon, it will silence you violently.

HAUNTER.dex_entry: Its tongue is made of gas. If licked, its victim starts shaking constantly until death eventually comes.

HAWLUCHA.dex_entry: It drives its opponents to exhaustion with its agile maneuvers, then ends the fight with a flashy finishing move.

HAXORUS.dex_entry: Its resilient tusks are its pride and joy. It licks up dirt to take in the minerals it needs to keep its tusks in top condition.

HEATMOR.dex_entry: There's a hole in its tail that allows it to draw in the air it needs to keep its fire burning. If the hole gets blocked, this Pokémon will fall ill.

HEATRAN.dex_entry: It dwells in volcanic caves. It digs in with its cross-shaped feet to crawl on ceilings and walls.

HELIOLISK.dex_entry: A now-vanished desert culture treasured these Pokémon. Appropriately, when Heliolisk came to the Galar region, treasure came with them.

HELIOPTILE.dex_entry: When spread, the frills on its head act like solar panels, generating the power behind this Pokémon's electric moves.

HERACROSS.dex_entry: Heracross loves sweet sap and will go looking through forests for it. The Pokémon uses its two antennae to pick up scents as it searches.

HERDIER.dex_entry: Herdier is a very smart and friendly Pokémon. So much so that there's a theory that Herdier was the first Pokémon to partner with people.

HIPPOPOTAS.dex_entry: It moves through the sands with its mouth open, swallowing sand along with its prey. It gets rid of the sand by spouting it from its nose.

HIPPOWDON.dex_entry: Stones can get stuck in the ports on their bodies. Dwebble help dislodge such stones, so Hippowdon look after these Pokémon.

HITMONCHAN.dex_entry: Its punches slice the air. They are launched at such high speed, even a slight graze could cause a burn.

HITMONLEE.dex_entry: This amazing Pokémon has an awesome sense of balance. It can kick in succession from any position.

HITMONTOP.dex_entry: It launches kicks while spinning. If it spins at high speed, it may bore its way into the ground.

HONCHKROW.dex_entry: A single cry from this nocturnal Pokémon, and more than a hundred of its Murkrow cronies will assemble.

HONEDGE.dex_entry: Honedge's soul once belonged to a person who was killed a long time ago by the sword that makes up Honedge's body.

HOOPA.dex_entry: In its true form, it possess a huge amount of power. Legends of its avarice tell how it once carried off an entire castle to gain the treasure hidden within.

HOOTHOOT.dex_entry: It always stands on one foot. It changes feet so fast, the movement can rarely be seen.

HOPPIP.dex_entry: This Pokémon drifts and floats with the wind. If it senses the approach of strong winds, Hoppip links its leaves with other Hoppip to prepare against being blown away.

HORSEA.dex_entry: Horsea makes its home in oceans with gentle currents. If this Pokémon is under attack, it spits out pitch-black ink and escapes.

HOUNDOOM.dex_entry: In a Houndoom pack, the one with its horns raked sharply toward the back serves a leadership role. These Pokémon choose their leader by fighting among themselves.

HOUNDOUR.dex_entry: Houndour hunt as a coordinated pack. They communicate with each other using a variety of cries to corner their prey. This Pokémon's remarkable teamwork is unparalleled.

HO_OH.dex_entry: Ho-Oh's feathers glow in seven colors depending on the angle at which they are struck by light. These feathers are said to bring happiness to the bearers. This Pokémon is said to live at the foot of a rainbow.

HUNTAIL.dex_entry: Huntail's presence went unnoticed by people for a long time because it lives at extreme depths in the sea. This Pokémon's eyes can see clearly even in the murky dark depths of the ocean.

HYDREIGON.dex_entry: There are a slew of stories about villages that were destroyed by Hydreigon. It bites anything that moves.

HYPNO.dex_entry: While it is an extremely dangerous Pokémon, people who are in need of a good, sound sleep call it their savior.

IGGLYBUFF.dex_entry: Igglybuff loves to sing. Its marshmallow-like body gives off a faint sweet smell.

ILLUMISE.dex_entry: Illumise attracts a swarm of Volbeat using a sweet fragrance. Once the Volbeat have gathered, this Pokémon leads the lit-up swarm in drawing geometric designs on the canvas of the night sky.

IMPIDIMP.dex_entry: Through its nose, it sucks in the emanations produced by people and Pokémon when they feel annoyed. It thrives off this negative energy.

INCINEROAR.dex_entry: It excels at violent, no-holds-barred battles. The temperature of the flames that issue from its navel exceeds 3,600 degrees Fahrenheit.

INDEEDEE_FEMALE.dex_entry: It uses the horns on its head to sense the emotions of others. Males will act as valets for those they serve, looking after their every need.

INDEEDEE_MALE.dex_entry: It uses the horns on its head to sense the emotions of others. Males will act as valets for those they serve, looking after their every need.

INFERNAPE.dex_entry: Its crown of fire is indicative of its fiery nature. It is beaten by none in terms of quickness.

INKAY.dex_entry: It spins while making its luminescent spots flash. These spots allow it to communicate with others by using different patterns of light.

INTELEON.dex_entry: Gigantamax Inteleon's Water Gun move fires at Mach 7. As the Pokémon takes aim, it uses the crest on its head to gauge wind and temperature.

IVYSAUR.dex_entry: When the bulb on its back grows large, it appears to lose the ability to stand on its hind legs.

JANGMO-O.dex_entry: They learn to fight by smashing their head scales together. The dueling strengthens both their skills and their spirits.

JELLICENT.dex_entry: Most of this Pokémon's body composition is identical to sea water. It makes sunken ships its lair.

JIGGLYPUFF.dex_entry: Jigglypuff has top-notch lung capacity, even by comparison to other Pokémon. It won't stop singing its lullabies until its foes fall asleep.

JIRACHI.dex_entry: Once every 1,000 years, the singing of a pure voice will rouse this Pokémon from its near- perpetual slumber. It wakes for only seven days.

JOLTEON.dex_entry: If it is angered or startled, the fur all over its body bristles like sharp needles that pierce foes.

JOLTIK.dex_entry: Joltik can be found clinging to other Pokémon. It's soaking up static electricity because it can't produce a charge on its own.

JUMPLUFF.dex_entry: Jumpluff rides warm southern winds to cross the sea and fly to foreign lands. The Pokémon descends to the ground when it encounters cold air while it is floating.

JYNX.dex_entry: Jynx walks rhythmically, swaying and shaking its hips as if it were dancing. Its motions are so bouncingly alluring, people seeing it are compelled to shake their hips without giving any thought to what they are doing.

KABUTO.dex_entry: Kabuto is a Pokémon that has been regenerated from a fossil. However, in extremely rare cases, living examples have been discovered. The Pokémon has not changed at all for 300 million years.

KABUTOPS.dex_entry: Kabutops swam underwater to hunt for its prey in ancient times. The Pokémon was apparently evolving from being a water dweller to living on land as evident from the beginnings of change in its gills and legs.

KADABRA.dex_entry: Using its psychic power, Kadabra levitates as it sleeps. It uses its springy tail as a pillow.

KAKUNA.dex_entry: Kakuna remains virtually immobile as it clings to a tree. However, on the inside, it is extremely busy as it prepares for its coming evolution. This is evident from how hot the shell becomes to the touch.

KANGASKHAN.dex_entry: Although it's carrying its baby in a pouch on its belly, Kangaskhan is swift on its feet. It intimidates its opponents with quick jabs.

KARRABLAST.dex_entry: Its strange physiology reacts to electrical energy in interesting ways. The presence of a Shelmet will cause this Pokémon to evolve.

KARTANA.dex_entry: This Ultra Beast came from the Ultra Wormhole. It seems not to attack enemies on its own, but its sharp body is a dangerous weapon in itself.

KECLEON.dex_entry: Kecleon is capable of changing its body colors at will to blend in with its surroundings. There is one exceptionthis Pokémon can't change the zigzag pattern on its belly.

KELDEO.dex_entry: It crosses the world, running over the surfaces of oceans and rivers. It appears at scenic waterfronts.

KINGDRA.dex_entry: With the arrival of a storm at sea, this Pokémon will show itself on the surface. When a Kingdra and a Dragonite meet, a fierce battle ensues.

KINGLER.dex_entry: Its large and hard pincer has 10,000-horsepower strength. However, being so big, it is unwieldy to move.

KIRLIA.dex_entry: If its Trainer becomes happy, it overflows with energy, dancing joyously while spinning about.

KLANG.dex_entry: When Klang goes all out, the minigear links up perfectly with the outer part of the big gear, and this Pokémon's rotation speed increases sharply.

KLEAVOR.dex_entry: This Pokémon is constantly collecting keys. Entrust a Klefki with important keys, and the Pokémon will protect them no matter what.

KLEFKI.dex_entry: This Pokémon is constantly collecting keys. Entrust a Klefki with important keys, and the Pokémon will protect them no matter what.

KLINK.dex_entry: The two minigears that compose this Pokémon are closer than twins. They mesh well only with each other.

KLINKLANG.dex_entry: From its spikes, it launches powerful blasts of electricity. Its red core contains an enormous amount of energy.

KOFFING.dex_entry: Its body is full of poisonous gas. It floats into garbage dumps, seeking out the fumes of raw, rotting trash.

KOMALA.dex_entry: It is born asleep, and it dies asleep. All its movements are apparently no more than the results of it tossing and turning in its dreams.

KOMMO-O.dex_entry: It clatters its tail scales to unnerve opponents. This Pokémon will battle only those who stand steadfast in the face of this display.

KRABBY.dex_entry: It can be found near the sea. The large pincers grow back if they are torn out of their sockets.

KRICKETOT.dex_entry: It chats with others using the sounds of its colliding antennae. These sounds are fall hallmarks.

KRICKETUNE.dex_entry: It crosses its knifelike arms in front of its chest when it cries. It can compose melodies ad lib.

KROKOROK.dex_entry: Krokorok has specialized eyes that enable it to see in the dark. This ability lets Krokorok hunt in the dead of night without getting lost.

KROOKODILE.dex_entry: This Pokémon is known as the Bully of the Sands. Krookodile's mighty jaws can bite through heavy plates of iron with almost no effort at all.

KUBFU.dex_entry: Kubfu trains hard to perfect its moves. The moves it masters will determine which form it takes when it evolves.

KYOGRE.dex_entry: Through Primal Reversion and with nature's full power, it will take back its true form. It can summon storms that cause the sea levels to rise.

KYUREM.dex_entry: Dwelling within it is a power even greater than that of Reshiram or Zekrom, but the extreme cold keeps that power bound.

LAIRON.dex_entry: Lairon tempers its steel body by drinking highly nutritious mineral springwater until it is bloated. This Pokémon makes its nest close to springs of delicious water.

LAMPENT.dex_entry: This Pokémon appears just before someone passes away, so it's feared as an emissary of death.

LANDORUS.dex_entry: Lands visited by Landorus grant such bountiful crops that it has been hailed as The Guardian of the Fields.

LANTURN.dex_entry: The light it emits is so bright that it can illuminate the sea's surface from a depth of over three miles.

LAPRAS.dex_entry: A smart and kindhearted Pokémon, it glides across the surface of the sea while its beautiful song echoes around it.

LARVESTA.dex_entry: The people of ancient times believed that Larvesta fell from the sun.

LARVITAR.dex_entry: Born deep underground, it comes aboveground and becomes a pupa once it has finished eating the surrounding soil.

LATIAS.dex_entry: Latias is highly sensitive to the emotions of people. If it senses any hostility, this Pokémon ruffles the feathers all over its body and cries shrilly to intimidate the foe.

LATIOS.dex_entry: Latios has the ability to make others see an image of what it has seen or imagines in its head. This Pokémon is intelligent and understands human speech.

LEAFEON.dex_entry: Galarians favor the distinctive aroma that drifts from this Pokémon's leaves. There's a popular perfume made using that scent.

LEAVANNY.dex_entry: Upon finding a small Pokémon, it weaves clothing for it from leaves by using the sticky silk secreted from its mouth.

LEDIAN.dex_entry: While it's believed that starlight provides it with energy, this Pokémon also loves to eat berries. In the daytime, it curls up in the grass to sleep.

LEDYBA.dex_entry: They are timid and grow uneasy when not in a swarm with others of their kind. The pattern on their backs differs slightly from one to another.

LICKILICKY.dex_entry: Lickilicky's strange tongue can stretch to many times the length of its body. No one has figured out how Lickilicky's tongue can stretch so far.

LICKITUNG.dex_entry: If this Pokémon's sticky saliva gets on you and you don't clean it off, an intense itch will set in. The itch won't go away, either.

LIEPARD.dex_entry: Don't be fooled by its gorgeous fur and elegant figure. This is a moody and vicious Pokémon.

LILEEP.dex_entry: Lileep became extinct approximately a hundred million years ago. This ancient Pokémon attaches itself to a rock on the seafloor and catches approaching prey using tentacles shaped like flower petals.

LILLIGANT.dex_entry: It's believed that even first-rate gardeners have a hard time getting the flower on a Lilligant's head to bloom.

LILLIPUP.dex_entry: This Pokémon is courageous but also cautious. It uses the soft fur covering its face to collect information about its surroundings.

LINOONE.dex_entry: It uses its long tongue to taunt opponents. Once the opposition is enraged, this Pokémon hurls itself at the opponent, tackling them forcefully.

LITLEO.dex_entry: The stronger the opponent it faces, the more heat surges from its mane and the more power flows through its body.

LITTEN.dex_entry: It spends even the smallest amount of downtime grooming its fur with its tongue. Loose fur gathers in its stomach and serves as fuel for fiery moves.

LITWICK.dex_entry: The flame on its head keeps its body slightly warm. This Pokémon takes lost children by the hand to guide them to the spirit world.

LOMBRE.dex_entry: It is nocturnal and becomes active at nightfall. It feeds on aquatic mosses that grow in the riverbed.

LOPUNNY.dex_entry: Lopunny is constantly monitoring its surroundings. If danger approaches, this Pokémon responds with superdestructive kicks.

LOTAD.dex_entry: It searches about for clean water. If it does not drink water for too long, the leaf on its head wilts.

LOUDRED.dex_entry: Loudred's ears serve as speakers, and they can put out sound waves powerful enough to blow away a house.

LUCARIO.dex_entry: It controls waves known as auras, which are powerful enough to pulverize huge rocks. It uses these waves to take down its prey.

LUDICOLO.dex_entry: The rhythm of bright, festive music activates Ludicolo's cells, making it more powerful.

LUGIA.dex_entry: Lugia's wings pack devastating powera light fluttering of its wings can blow apart regular houses. As a result, this Pokémon chooses to live out of sight deep under the sea.

LUMINEON.dex_entry: With its shining light, it lures its prey close. However, the light also happens to attract ferocious fish Pokémonits natural predators.

LUNALA.dex_entry: Known as the Beast That Calls the Moon, this Pokémon lives by taking in any and all light and converting it into its own energy.

LUNATONE.dex_entry: The phase of the moon apparently has some effect on its power. It's active on the night of a full moon.

LURANTIS.dex_entry: This Pokémon resembles a beautiful flower. A properly raised Lurantis will have gorgeous, brilliant colors.

LUVDISC.dex_entry: If a Luvdisc is left on its own, it becomes despondent, leaving itself open to attack. That is when Pelipper snatch them up.

LUXIO.dex_entry: By joining its tail with that of another Luxio, this Pokémon can receive some of the other Luxio's electricity and power up its own electric blasts.

LUXRAY.dex_entry: Luxray can see through solid objects. It will instantly spot prey trying to hide behind walls, even if the walls are thick.

LYCANROC.dex_entry: This Lycanroc is calm and cautious. The rocks jutting from its mane are razor sharp.

MACHAMP.dex_entry: It quickly swings its four arms to rock its opponents with ceaseless punches and chops from all angles.

MACHOKE.dex_entry: Its muscular body is so powerful, it must wear a power-save belt to be able to regulate its motions.

MACHOP.dex_entry: Its whole body is composed of muscles. Even though it's the size of a human child, it can hurl 100 grown-ups.

MAGBY.dex_entry: Many of these Pokémon can be seen in areas with volcanic activity. Feeding can get them so excited, they exhale flames of 1,100 degrees F.

MAGCARGO.dex_entry: Magcargo's shell is actually its skin that hardened as a result of cooling. Its shell is very brittle and fragilejust touching it causes it to crumble apart. This Pokémon returns to its original size by dipping itself in magma.

MAGEARNA.dex_entry: This artificial Pokémon, constructed more than 500 years ago, can understand human speech but cannot itself speak.

MAGIKARP.dex_entry: It is virtually worthless in terms of both power and speed. It is the most weak and pathetic Pokémon in the world.

MAGMAR.dex_entry: When it's tired, it leaps into the mouth of a volcano and soaks its body in magma to ease its weariness. Its body burns at 2,192 degrees F.

MAGMORTAR.dex_entry: They dwell in volcanic craters. According to what is known, a single pair of male and female Magmortar lives in one volcano.

MAGNEMITE.dex_entry: At times, Magnemite runs out of electricity and ends up on the ground. If you give batteries to a grounded Magnemite, it'll start moving again.

MAGNETON.dex_entry: This Pokémon is three Magnemite that have linked together. Magneton sends out powerful radio waves to study its surroundings.

MAGNEZONE.dex_entry: Some say that Magnezone receives signals from space via the antenna on its head and that it's being controlled by some mysterious being.

MAKUHITA.dex_entry: It was originally brought in from another region, but now Makuhita from Alola are more famous.

MALAMAR.dex_entry: Gazing at its luminescent spots will quickly induce a hypnotic state, putting the observer under Malamar's control.

MAMOSWINE.dex_entry: This Pokémon can be spotted in wall paintings from as far back as 10,000 years ago. For a while, it was thought to have gone extinct.

MANAPHY.dex_entry: It is born with a wondrous power that lets it bond with any kind of Pokémon.

MANDIBUZZ.dex_entry: Although it's a bit of a ruffian, this Pokémon will take lost Vullaby under its wing and care for them till they're ready to leave the nest.

MANECTRIC.dex_entry: It stimulates its own muscles with electricity, so it can move quickly. It eases its soreness with electricity, too, so it can recover quickly as well.

MANKEY.dex_entry: It can spontaneously become enraged. Everyone near it clears out as it rampages, and the resulting loneliness makes it angrier still.

MANTINE.dex_entry: If it builds up enough speed swimming, it can jump out above the waves and glide for over 300 feet.

MANTYKE.dex_entry: Mantyke living in Galar seem to be somewhat sluggish. The colder waters of the seas in this region may be the cause.

MARACTUS.dex_entry: With noises that could be mistaken for the rattles of maracas, it creates an upbeat rhythm, startling bird Pokémon and making them fly off in a hurry.

MAREANIE.dex_entry: The first symptom of its sting is numbness. The next is an itching sensation so intense that it's impossible to resist the urge to claw at your skin.

MAREEP.dex_entry: Mareep's fluffy coat of wool rubs together and builds a static charge. The more static electricity is charged, the more brightly the lightbulb at the tip of its tail glows.

MARILL.dex_entry: This Pokémon uses its round tail as a float. The ball of Marill's tail is filled with nutrients that have been turned into an oil.

MAROWAK.dex_entry: This Pokémon overcame its sorrow to evolve a sturdy new body. Marowak faces its opponents bravely, using a bone as a weapon.

MAROWAK_ALOLAN.dex_entry: This Pokémon overcame its sorrow to evolve a sturdy new body. Marowak faces its opponents bravely, using a bone as a weapon.

MARSHADOW.dex_entry: By slipping into the shadow of a martial arts master and copying their movements, this Pokémon learned the ultimate techniques.

MARSHTOMP.dex_entry: The surface of Marshtomp's body is enveloped by a thin, sticky film that enables it to live on land. This Pokémon plays in mud on beaches when the ocean tide is low.

MASQUERAIN.dex_entry: It intimidates enemies with the eye-like patterns on its antennae. Its four wings allow it to fly in any direction.

MAWILE.dex_entry: It uses its docile-looking face to lull foes into complacency, then bites with its huge, relentless jaws.

MEDICHAM.dex_entry: It is said that through meditation, Medicham heightens energy inside its body and sharpens its sixth sense. This Pokémon hides its presence by merging itself with fields and mountains.

MEDITITE.dex_entry: Meditite undertakes rigorous mental training deep in the mountains. However, whenever it meditates, this Pokémon always loses its concentration and focus. As a result, its training never ends.

MEGANIUM.dex_entry: The fragrance of Meganium's flower soothes and calms emotions. In battle, this Pokémon gives off more of its becalming scent to blunt the foe's fighting spirit.

MELMETAL.dex_entry: At the end of its life-span, Melmetal will rust and fall apart. The small shards left behind will eventually be reborn as Meltan.

MELOETTA.dex_entry: The melodies sung by Meloetta have the power to make Pokémon that hear them happy or sad.

MELTAN.dex_entry: It dissolves and eats metal. Circulating liquid metal within its body is how it generates energy.

MEOWSTIC_FEMALE.dex_entry: Females are a bit more selfish and aggressive than males. If they don't get what they want, they will torment you with their psychic abilities.

MEOWSTIC_MALE.dex_entry: Females are a bit more selfish and aggressive than males. If they don't get what they want, they will torment you with their psychic abilities.

MEOWTH.dex_entry: It loves to collect shiny things. If it's in a good mood, it might even let its Trainer have a look at its hoard of treasures.

MESPRIT.dex_entry: Known as The Being of Emotion. It taught humans the nobility of sorrow, pain, and joy.

METAGROSS.dex_entry: It firmly pins its prey using its four claws and large body. Then the teeth in the mouth on its stomach chew the prey to bits.

METANG.dex_entry: When two Beldum link together, their psychic power is doubled. Their intelligence, however, remains unchanged.

METAPOD.dex_entry: It is waiting for the moment to evolve. At this stage, it can only harden, so it remains motionless to avoid attack.

MEW.dex_entry: Mew is said to possess the genetic composition of all Pokémon. It is capable of making itself invisible at will, so it entirely avoids notice even if it approaches people.

MEWTWO.dex_entry: Mewtwo is a Pokémon that was created by genetic manipulation. However, even though the scientific power of humans created this Pokémon's body, they failed to endow Mewtwo with a compassionate heart.

MIENFOO.dex_entry: In one minute, a well-trained Mienfoo can chop with its arms more than 100 times.

MIENSHAO.dex_entry: When Mienshao comes across a truly challenging opponent, it will lighten itself by biting off the fur on its arms.

MIGHTYENA.dex_entry: Mightyena gives obvious signals when it is preparing to attack. It starts to growl deeply and then flattens its body. This Pokémon will bite savagely with its sharply pointed fangs.

MILCERY.dex_entry: This Pokémon was born from sweet-smelling particles in the air. Its body is made of cream.

MILOTIC.dex_entry: Milotic has provided inspiration to many artists. It has even been referred to as the most beautiful Pokémon of all.

MILTANK.dex_entry: Miltank produces highly nutritious milk, so it's been supporting the lives of people and other Pokémon since ancient times.

MIME_JR.dex_entry: It mimics everyone it sees, but it puts extra effort into copying the graceful dance steps of Mr. Rime as practice.

MIMIKYU.dex_entry: It wears a rag fashioned into a Pikachu costume in an effort to look less scary. Unfortunately, the costume only makes it creepier.

MINCCINO.dex_entry: The way it brushes away grime with its tail can be helpful when cleaning. But its focus on spotlessness can make cleaning more of a hassle.

MINIOR.dex_entry: Originally making its home in the ozone layer, it hurtles to the ground when the shell enclosing its body grows too heavy.

MINUN.dex_entry: Minun is more concerned about cheering on its partners than its own safety. It shorts out the electricity in its body to create brilliant showers of sparks to cheer on its teammates.

MISDREAVUS.dex_entry: It will use any means necessary to frighten people and absorb their life energy. It practices constantly to hone its skill in causing fear.

MISMAGIUS.dex_entry: It appears as if from nowheremuttering incantations, placing curses, and giving people terrifying visions.
